name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersC_le
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      (∀ (x : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x → LE.le.{0} (c x) L) →
        ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
          (∀ (a : Prod.{0, 0} ν ν),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} U a → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N) a) →
            LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} U) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) →
              LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersC N c U)
                (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersB
                  (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N))
                  (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) L)

source.code:
theorem layersC_le (hN : N.Ok) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x ∈ N.nodes, c x ≤ L) (U : List (ν × ν))
    (hU : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs) (hm : U.length ≤ N.arcs.length) :
    N.layersC c U ≤ layersB N.nodes.length N.arcs.length L := by
  unfold layersC layersB
  have h1 := N.layersAuxC_le c hN L hL U hU hm N.nodes.length [] [N.s] List.nodup_nil
    (List.nodup_singleton _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simpa using hN.s_mem) le_rfl
  have h2 := hL _ hN.s_mem
  omega
